tests: The approaching inactive slot icon now travels a colour journey driven only by proximity d = |position - slot|: dim inactive tint (onSurfaceVariant) at rest, through the theme accent (primary) at ~60%
description: The approaching inactive slot icon now travels a colour journey driven only by proximity d = |position - slot|: dim inactive tint (onSurfaceVariant) at rest, through the theme accent (primary) at ~60% progress, arriving at onPrimary, the exact colour of the thumb glyph, by d = NEAR, so the hand-off under the thumb has no colour pop. Interpolation is piecewise in Oklab (new pure Oklab/SlotColorJourney helpers, no dependencies), avoiding muddy mid-tones. Colours come from MaterialTheme.colorScheme, so light, dark and dynamic themes all work. Rest (d >= 1) is exactly today's tint. Replaces the brightened second Icon copy with a single painter tinted in drawBehind, reading the thumb position in the draw phase (no recomposition). Adds JVM tests for rest equality, arrival, accent pass-through, continuity, monotonicity, symmetry, clamping and Oklab lerp.
